def safe_timeout(text: str) -> int:
    """Parse a timeout string into milliseconds and clamp to a safe range."""
    from core.utils import parse_duration, clamp

    raw_ms = parse_duration(text)
    return clamp(raw_ms, 0, 1_000_000)

def prepare_batches(keys, size):
    """Deduplicate record keys and split them into fixed-size batches."""
